triggers.summary: Let me now turn to our business performance for the quarter ended September ’26: I am pleased to share that Q2 Financial Year 27 was a better quarter for us compared to Q1, both in terms of revenue and operating profitability with total operating income growing 12% sequentially and EBITDA more than doubling over the previous quarter. During Q2, we witnessed an improvement in performance with NIP and OTF revenue growing 84% year-on-year to Rs 149 million…
triggers.detailsText: Let me now turn to our business performance for the quarter ended September ’26: I am pleased to share that Q2 Financial Year 27 was a better quarter for us compared to Q1, both in terms of revenue and operating profitability with total operating income growing 12% sequentially and EBITDA more than doubling over the previous quarter. During Q2, we witnessed an improvement in performance with NIP and OTF revenue growing 84% year-on-year to Rs 149 million, taking its contribution to 14% of the total operating income from 9% in Q2 Financial Year ‘26. The export contributes approximately 86% of the total operating income during the quarter, while our NIP and OT F portfolio generated revenue of approximately Rs 149 million, accounting to 14% of total operating income, or 16%, including dossier license fees.

During Q2, we witnessed an improvement in performance with NIP and OTF revenue growing 84% year-on-year to Rs 149 million, taking its contribution to 14% of the total operating income from 9% in Q2 Financial Year ‘26.

The third quarter illustrated this flexibility: as shipping in the Persian Gulf partially recovered, we resumed deliveries to Middle East smelters, having made none in the second quarter. triggers.detailsText: Commenting on the performance, Mr Satish Kumar Reddy, Chairman and Independent Director, Sical Logistics Limited, said, “Q2FY27 was a quarter of steady performance, as we reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 1,055 Million, growing 17.4% YoY, taking our revenue for H1 FY27 to Rs 2,380 Million, which grew 27.1% YoY. triggers.detailsText: We delivered a total revenue of almost INR150 crores, INR148.7 crores to be precise, which was an increase of 68% over the corresponding quarter for last year. The presentation we have uploaded sets out an FY27 revenue target of well over INR500 crores and long-term revenue aspirations in the region of INR1,000 crores by FY30 and going towards INR2,000 crores beyond FY32, FY33. And I would dedicate this quarter mainly to our operations and sourcing team because all the strategic investments in deciding to pursue strategic programs at the customers, investments in the product portfolio, manufacturing and all were already put multiple quarters before.
filingKeyFacts: We delivered a total revenue of almost INR150 crores, INR148.7 crores to be precise, which was an increase of 68% over the corresponding quarter for last year.

And I would dedicate this quarter mainly to our operations and sourcing team because all the strategic investments in deciding to pursue strategic programs at the customers, investments in the product portfolio, manufacturing and all were already put multiple quarters before.
